newsitem.title: INDIA: India's rulers take no decision on oil prices.
newsitem.headline: India's rulers take no decision on oil prices.

text.p: India's ruling United Front coalition discussed the possibility of raising the domestic prices of some petroleum products on Sunday but took no decision, a participant in the meeting said.

"The main issue discussed was petroleum. No decision has been taken. Several chief ministers were not there. There could be another meeting," the senior United Front leader, who asked not to be identified, told reporters.
The leader spoke after the 2-1/2-hour meeting ended.
Information Minister Jaipal Reddy was scheduled to address a news conference later on Sunday.
Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral's 15-party centre-left coalition has been considering raising the prices of some petroleum products to plug a ballooning subsidy bill.
